title: EgoSocial
summary: EgoSocial is a 13,500-pair egocentric video-question benchmark built from Ego4D for judging when an AR/VR assistant should intervene in a social situation, paired with EgoSoD, a social-thinking-graph method that fuses audio and visual cues. We are turning it into Meridian's social-awareness eval and data asset for assistant products.
